name: Grand Hotel Savoia
insider_take: Nestled in the heart of the Dolomites UNESCO World Heritage site, this Belle Époque gem has been the crown jewel of Cortina d'Ampezzo since 1912, hosting royalty and Hollywood stars against the backdrop of Italy's most dramatic alpine peaks.
whats_special: The Grand Hotel Savoia sits directly on Corso Italia, Cortina's glamorous pedestrian boulevard, where Prada and Gucci boutiques line the streets beneath the towering Tofane mountains. This historic hotel served as a filming location for the 1981 James Bond film "For Your Eyes Only" and continues to attract A-listers during the winter social season.
pro_tip: Book a south-facing room for unobstructed views of the iconic Pomagagnon mountain, and time your visit during the Coppa d'Oro ski race in December when Cortina's social calendar reaches its peak.
dont_miss: The hotel's legendary aperitivo hour on the sun terrace, where champagne flows as the Dolomites turn pink during the famous "alpenglow" phenomenon. Just steps away, explore the Regole d'Ampezzo Nature Park, home to ancient Ladin culture and some of Europe's most pristine mountain hiking trails.
pros: Prime location in the heart of Cortina d'Ampezzo with easy access to ski slopes and shopping
Historic grand hotel with elegant Alpine architecture and traditional Italian hospitality
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with mountain views
Exceptional fine dining restaurant featuring regional Dolomites cuisine
cons: Premium pricing reflects exclusive Cortina location
Traditional decor may feel formal for some guests
